name: Alasinthe
bio: Alasinthe grew up happy and wild on the caravan roads of the volcanic Southern Thursians, where she befriended a baby skink. She named it Candle, after all the little fires it liked to start. Fires that Alasinthe would learn to master, not long after her Arcana awakened and she became a Magi.

effects.label: Crit Rate Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Crit Rate stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Crit DMG Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Crit Damage stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.
